`pods "app-575b7496bc-..." is forbidden: exceeded quota: app-quota, requested: pods=1, used: pods=2, limited: pods=2`

The Deployment reported `Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable)`, `replicas: 2/3`, and the ReplicaSet stayed at `DESIRED 3 / CURRENT 2`.

**Fix (smallest justified change, quota kept in place):** raised only the pod ceiling of the existing ResourceQuota to 3.

```
kubectl patch resourcequota app-quota -n default --type merge \
  -p '{"spec":{"hard":{"pods":"3"}}}'   # now hard.pods = "3", used = 3/3
```

- Deployment: `READY 3/3`, `UP-TO-DATE 3`, `AVAILABLE 3` — matches the requested replica count exactly.

- Running image is the intended one on every replica: `docker.io/library/nginx:1.31.5`.
- Functional check inside a pod confirmed the app actually serves traffic: `curl http://localhost/` returned the nginx welcome page (`<title>Welcome to nginx!</title>`).
- Resource quota constraint remains active and enforced: `app-quota  pods: 3/3`, i.e. the quota is present but no longer undersized for the desired replica count.

No other settings (Deployment spec, image, pod template) were changed, and no transient object was deleted or restarted.
